digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering and indexing
propositions: ADR numbering has 17 duplicate numbers across 91 files with only 69 distinct numbers, causing ambiguity and stranded references
Collisions occur from stale-base merges and in-flight races; pre-merge CI checks are insufficient but per-number marker files create git add/add conflicts to prevent duplicates
22 ADRs must be renumbered to 0070–0091 (ascending landing-date order) with earliest-landed keeping its original number
All cross-references to moved ADRs (slug-bearing links and context-disambiguated bare references) must be rewritten to their new numbers and recorded in RENUMBERING.md with resolution tiers
A referential-integrity CI gate (check_adr_numbers.py) must enforce bijection between ADRs and markers, unique numbers, and that no dangling slug-based links remain in docs/ and src/
A generated docs/adr/README.md index grouped by workstream and a RENUMBERING.md disambiguation table must provide historical disambiguation for the 90 extant references to collision numbers
